title: Merge k Sorted Lists
description: You are given an array `lists` of `k` linked lists, each sorted in non-decreasing order. Merge them all into a single sorted linked list and return its head.
constraints: The total number of nodes is at most 10^4.
hints: Merging two sorted lists is easy; how can you reuse that?
Merge the lists pairwise in rounds (divide and conquer), or keep the k current heads in a min-heap.
